title: Critical Industrial Discharge — Okhla Phase II
gemini_summary: Unpermitted tire/waste combustion confirmed by 9 visual reports and local PM2.5 sensor spike to 248 µg/m³. Severe immediate respiratory hazard for neighboring residential colonies.
recommended_intervention:
1. Dispatch hazardous emissions inspection unit to Block C industrial quadrant.
2. Issue school outdoor recess suspension advisory within 2.5km radius.
3. Deploy misting cannons along Maa Anandmayee Marg corridor.

title: Cross-Border Crop Residue Fire Plume — Amritsar Border
gemini_summary: Intense stubble combustion cluster generating eastward-moving smoke corridor across international border. High particulate density (PM2.5: 192 µg/m³).
recommended_intervention:
1. Alert District Agricultural Magistrate for rapid mechanized fire suppression.
2. Trigger bilateral cross-border clean air coordination bulletin.

action_log.actor: Officer H. Singh (Punjab Pollution Control Board)
action_log.notes: Acknowledged. Dispatched field team with agricultural balers.
